text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the year-end race, the Arima Kinen. The day Tokai Teio has been waiting for has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She enthusiastically explains how she hopes that defeating Symboli Rudolf will begin to change her fans' image of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio heads to the race like her usual energetic self.
